summary: Cabaletta Bio filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a planned clinical data presentation at the ASGCT 2026 Annual Meeting. The filing details early results from 4 refractory pemphigus vulgaris patients receiving rese-cel without preconditioning, showing biologic activity and safety. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special-situation corporate event is discussed. The filing is purely a clinical update and routine current report.
